senses.sense_definition: The quality of being clear and easy to understand in expression.

examples.text: The professor was praised for the <w>perspicuity</w> of his lectures on complex physics.
The report lacked <w>perspicuity</w>, making it difficult for the board to understand the main points.

senses.sense_definition: The ability to notice and understand things that are not obvious; keen insight.

examples.text: She showed great <w>perspicuity</w> in identifying the hidden motives behind his sudden resignation.
His <w>perspicuity</w> allowed him to solve the mystery long before the police arrived.

senses.sense_definition: The state of being transparent or allowing light to pass through.

examples.text: The <w>perspicuity</w> of the thin glass allowed the sunlight to flood the entire room.
The water in the mountain stream had a remarkable <w>perspicuity</w> that revealed the stones below.
